messages:
alex: quick heads up — noticed p95 and p99 on the new latency dashboard disagree with raw endpoint breakdowns for the /generate route. p95 looks fine but p99 is ~40ms higher than expected. anyone else?
mel: saw that too. seems to only affect routes with lots of short requests (<= 64 tokens). could be bucketization rounding? :thinking_face:
sam: what query are you running? dashboard uses tdigest rollups, endpoint breakdowns are per-shard raw samples. sample origin mismatch maybe.
alex: here's the raw snippet i pulled from the console (route=/generate, window=5m):
```
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) as p95, percentile(latency_ms, 99) as p99
FROM trace_events
WHERE route = '/generate' AND timestamp > now() - interval '5 minutes';
```
Result: p95=78, p99=230 (console panel p99=270).
jin: hmm the console panel applies bucketization into 10ms buckets for the histogram -> then tdigest on buckets. that adds quantization error especially at tail for low-latency-heavy mixes.
sam: confirmed. i reproduced by forcing 5ms buckets locally, p99 shifted up ~15-25%. using raw sample tdigest (no bucketizing) matches the SQL.
mel: do we bucketize for storage reasons? i remember a tradeoff for retention and index size.
jin: yes—long-term rollups use bucketed histograms to save space and speed queries. short windows (5m) should probably prefer raw samples but the dashboard uses rollup path because of how the panels are wired.
alex: UX problem then. dashboard is giving people a different signal than endpoint breakdown. folks triaging incidents will panic. can we expose an explicit "use_raw_samples" toggle per-panel?
sam: +1. alternative: auto-select raw samples if sample_count > 100k in window and max_latency < 500ms? heuristic detection.
mel: or show a small warning badge when tdigest/bucketized source is used: "percentiles derived from histogram rollups — may overestimate tail" with a link to docs. lower friction than adding config.
jin: both ok. engineering-wise adding a panel flag is small but requires console API + panel state change. warning badge is easiest.
alex: short-term: badge + docs. medium-term: panel toggle. long-term: re-evaluate bucket size heuristics for low-latency dominated routes.
deploybot: deploy scheduled: dashboard-badge-update -> staging at 03:00 UTC. CI green. :shipit:
sam: i'll file a tiny RFC for the toggle + diagnostic flag so we can A/B test behavior on a handful of accounts.
mel: cool. alex can you add an example query and a screenshot to the RFC showing the discrepancy? makes review faster.
alex: on it. i'll attach both and add a proposed copy for the badge.
jin: also add a note about how model-variant routing can inflate p99 (fallbacks to slower models create a long-tail even if main path is fast). seen that bit as well.
alex: good call. will include. thanks all :)
mel: thanks. followups in RFC thread.
